exists_call.side_effects: reads filesystem stat; result is True iff path exists at call time

analysis_notes: The predicate Path(defaultPath).exists() has no user-supplied public inputs. defaultPath is a local variable assigned unconditionally from the module-level constant DEFAULT_ROCM_BIN_PATH_WINDOWS = Path('C:/Program Files/AMD/ROCm'), which is a hardcoded string literal. No environment variable, CLI argument, YAML key, or interactive input reaches defaultPath. The sole source of non-determinism is the filesystem: whether the Windows ROCm install path C:/Program Files/AMD/ROCm exists at runtime. On POSIX (Linux/macOS) the enclosing function _windowsSearchPaths is never called (callers gate on os.name == nt), so the predicate is unreachable on non-Windows platforms.
